info.name: Spring Boot 3 Actuator Environment Health API

items.docs: Returns the overall health status of the application. Aggregates all registered HealthIndicators. When security is enabled, full details are only shown to authorized users.

params.name: component
params.description: Health component name (e.g., db, diskSpace, redis)

items.docs: Returns the health status of a specific component (e.g., db, diskSpace, redis, rabbit, kafka).
